tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a home for sale or rent in the Czech Republic — a flat, house, cottage or building plot — by layout (2+kk, 3+1…), town, district or city part, price, floor area or features. Covers listings agencies and sellers published on LivinIsto directly and public listings

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for more about one specific home returned by search_properties (floor, condition, construction, ownership, energy class, balcony, lift, parking, price history). Requires the property id from search_properties; do not guess ids. Returns the facts LivinIsto shows on the lis

tools.name: get_price_per_m2
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much homes cost per square metre in a Czech town or city part, or whether a price per m² is reasonable. Returns the median ASKING price per m² of the municipality (monthly for rent) from LivinIsto's monthly index, with the sample size and month; with a layout (2+kk, 3

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_price_per_m2" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
